ONE 3D-rendered chibi illustration. Reference = art style for the ENTIRE image (not a sticker).

STYLE: [STYLE]. Distant scenery = simpler 3D forms in cooler tones with gentle depth; keep it clean and readable.

ALL figures (soldiers, crowds, bystanders) share identical 2.5-head chibi proportions, oversized round head, stubby limbs and soft rounded hands, and the same soft 3D shading, cinematic lighting and material finish as the main character. Never flat, cel-shaded, sketchier, semi-realistic or silhouetted. A crowd = many small fully-modelled chibi characters, never a textured mass.

ONE CULTURE ONLY: Follow the SCENE’s country + century for architecture, costumes, armour, banners and weapons. Strictly no mixing (especially Chinese ↔ Vietnamese).

MAIN CHARACTER: Locked to reference — same face, hair, skin, proportions, costume, armour, colours and weapon. Only pose, expression, orientation, action, camera angle and lighting may change. Never redesign face/armour. Extras wear plainer gear; never copy main character’s face, helmet or golden armour.

BARE SURFACES: every banner, flag, shield and wall is one uninterrupted field of a single colour, edge to edge — dyed cloth showing only folds and hem, plain painted wood, bare stone. Keep all surfaces completely blank and non-symbolic.

TYPOGRAPHY BAN: no visible glyphs, marks arranged as writing, or typographic decoration anywhere in the frame. Visual information must use shapes, colour, plain dots and plain lines only.
